title: Task
description: One unit of work: specs/<epic>/tasks/<ID>.md. The frontmatter is the coordination substrate (board, loop, claiming); the body is what the coder builds against. A backward-compatible superset of agentic-template's task frontmatter: every field the template writes keeps its meaning, every harness field is optional.

id.description: Stable, unique, never reused. Must equal the file name.

parent.description: Parent task id when this is a subtask.

cuj.description: The journey(s) this task serves: one id (template form), a list (harness), or null.

branch.description: The task's working branch; one worktree per task keys off it.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must be merged before this one is claimed.

owner.description: null = an agent may claim the first pass; otherwise the human or agent holding it. The owner/status pair is the claim lock.

kickback_reason.description: Required by the interjection protocol when a task is moved to an earlier stage (or as the first agent-log line).

requirements.description: Harness: the REQ/NFR ids of the epic this task implements. The trace check requires at least one at readiness.

touches.description: Harness: path globs the task expects to modify. Tasks whose touches overlap are one lane and run in sequence.

inputs.description: Harness: what must exist before the task can start, beyond guiding_docs: a path, or a named secret, service, decision or dataset.

risk.description: Harness: high or irreversible work is never run inside an unsupervised loop.

evaluator.description: Harness: what decides the criteria are met, in the order it runs.

ref.description: A command, a path, or a role (code-owner).

budget.description: Harness: ceilings for the whole task across runs. A runner stops at the first one reached.

sessions.description: Harness: sessions that worked this task, appended by the agent in its handoff (the runner never writes the task file).

mode.description: Harness: the methodology that selects skills for this task (playbook/methodology/modes.md). Not the runtime's engagement mode.

allOf.description: A claimed task has an owner: the owner/status pair is the lock.
